sources.title: Correction: Impact of replacing smear microscopy with Xpert MTB/RIF for diagnosing tuberculosis in Brazil (PLoS Med 2015;12:e1001928)
sources.effect_on_page: Read in full by Claude Code, 2026-10-22. After 147 duplicate entries were removed the authors re-analysed and published a revised Table 4 (notification rates); the primary-endpoint rate ratio moved from 1.59 (95% CI 1.31–1.88) to 1.60 (1.31–1.89), and the authors state the conclusions are unaffected. Any notification figure the page takes from S012 is taken from the revised table in S013.
